source_of_truth_note: Extends docs/CAPABILITY-CONTRACT.md (2026-09-05, ADR-290-300) with a live production re-verification pass performed 2026-09-06. Statuses here that differ from docs/CAPABILITY-CONTRACT.md are flagged in notes; that file itself is only updated via a founder-authored ADR, which this pack does not do. Anything not listed here is UNKNOWN, not GREEN. Do not infer support from a category simply existing in the catalog.

status_vocabulary.GREEN: verified working in production, with a citable test/ADR/live repro
status_vocabulary.YELLOW_PARTIAL: works in some cases, not others; the gap is known and disclosed
status_vocabulary.RED_UNSUPPORTED: deliberately not modeled as a capability, or a live check found it non-functional -- never claim publicly

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper states a maximum budget (بحد أقصى / بميزانية) for any product category
capabilities.supported_behavior: Budget parsed and applied as a hard ceiling; shown as an explicit banner and a removable chip
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: None known for standard MSA/Gulf budget phrasing
capabilities.known_limitations: Only tested with بحد أقصى (ADR-291) and بميزانية (live 2026-09-06); other colloquial phrasings not exhaustively tested
capabilities.safe_claim: Tell Tawveeri your budget in plain Arabic or English and it will only show options within it
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Tawveeri understands every possible way to phrase a budget
capabilities.live_repro: أبي ثلاجة صغيرة وقفلها مهم | مكيف لغرفة 25 متر بميزانية 2500 | جوال كاميرا ممتازة بميزانية 2000
capabilities.notes: Re-verified live in this session across 3 categories with the same-day date

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper wants a small/compact refrigerator
capabilities.supported_behavior: Evidence-based threshold (≤200L = small, from real catalog distribution) applied as a preference chip; results captioned with the matching capacity
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: None known
capabilities.known_limitations: Threshold is catalog-distribution-derived, not a fixed universal definition of 'small'
capabilities.safe_claim: Tell Tawveeri you want a small fridge and it will prioritize genuinely compact units
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Tawveeri's size categories match every brand's own size labeling
capabilities.notes: Live-confirmed: chip 'small' shown, top 4 results 200L/200L/130L/80L each captioned 'small as requested'

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper says a lock/key on the refrigerator matters to them
capabilities.supported_behavior: The request is never silently dropped and never used to fabricate a filter; a caution is disclosed on every result instead
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: Tawveeri does NOT filter or verify which refrigerators actually have a lock
capabilities.known_limitations: Lock evidence exists in some Amazon titles but is too thin/single-provider to structure as a trustworthy filter
capabilities.safe_claim: If you mention a lock matters, Tawveeri will tell you honestly it can't verify that and to check the listing yourself -- it will never guess or fabricate
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Tawveeri can find you a refrigerator with a lock
capabilities.notes: Live-confirmed: identical warning text shown on every result -- this IS the flagship honesty differentiator, framed correctly it is a GREEN brand claim even though the underlying filter is RED

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper states a room size in square meters and wants a matching AC capacity (BTU)
capabilities.supported_behavior: Room size parsed to a chip; results captioned with the matching BTU capacity and rationale
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: None known
capabilities.known_limitations: Amazon has zero valid AC listings (ADR-295) -- comparisons for AC are effectively single-provider-thin on the merchant-breadth side even though the capacity-matching itself works
capabilities.safe_claim: Tell Tawveeri your room size and budget for an AC and it will match the right cooling capacity for you
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Tawveeri compares AC prices across all 8 active merchants equally -- Amazon has no AC catalog
capabilities.notes: New capability row -- recommend a formal ADR to register this permanently in docs/CAPABILITY-CONTRACT.md

capabilities.safe_claim: Tell Tawveeri camera matters most and give a budget -- it will prioritize accordingly and explain why
capabilities.unsafe_claim: none identified
capabilities.evidence_reference: docs/CAPABILITY-CONTRACT.md row 2; re-verified live 2026-09-06 (supersedes prior 'not independently re-verified' caveat)

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper wants to know if a listing is new/renewed/refurbished/used
capabilities.supported_behavior: Storefront layer preserves condition text from titles (e.g. 'Renewed -'); a strict internal engine (Amazon x Noon) never guesses when evidence is thin
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: The canonical/identity layer strips condition markers; only 3 of 50 real Amazon x Noon overlap pairs are safely comparable on condition, 47 correctly resolve UNKNOWN rather than guess
capabilities.known_limitations: Condition disclosure depth depends on which layer/surface renders the product
capabilities.safe_claim: Tawveeri never assumes a listing is new -- when it can't confirm the condition, it says so instead of guessing
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Tawveeri always tells you the exact condition of every listing
capabilities.live_repro: not re-run live this session (internal engine, not directly exposed in the 3 public journeys tested)
capabilities.notes: This is the same honesty pattern as the refrigerator-lock finding -- reinforces the anchor brand claim

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper searches for a product not yet in the catalog, expecting Tawveeri to go find and add it
capabilities.supported_behavior: A safety mechanism exists and is proven to never fabricate a product from sparse data
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: No genuinely-new-to-catalog product has ever been proven added via this pipeline; two live test attempts both correctly returned no result rather than a fabricated one
capabilities.known_limitations: The honest public claim is catalog depth for named-model searches, not live auto-discovery
capabilities.safe_claim: Tawveeri's catalog is deep for named-model searches (e.g. a specific Galaxy Tab model)
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Search for anything and Tawveeri will find and add it automatically
capabilities.notes: High risk of misuse in marketing -- explicitly guard against this framing in governance

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper clicks a suggested follow-up like 'what if I raise my budget by 500?' expecting the results to update
capabilities.supported_behavior: Confirmed working: each chip re-issues a fresh natural-language query and returns an honest, explicit answer. 'lo raf3t al-mizaniya 500?' (raise budget by 500) returned an explicit stated verdict: the recommendation does not change, staying the same pick even at the higher budget. 'tayyib arkhas?' (cheaper?) returned an explicit before/after comparison card with two different real prices.
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: None found on re-verification. 'why is this better?' and 'where do I buy it?' were not click-tested this pass (only 'raise budget' and 'cheaper' were).
capabilities.known_limitations: None confirmed. STALE-CLAIM CORRECTION: an earlier live test this same session reported zero visible change on click and was recorded as GAP-1 / RED. That observation was invalidated by a final event-driven reproduction (native element.click() instead of coordinate-based mouse simulation) run later the same day -- root cause was a browser-automation coordinate/devicePixelRatio mismatch in the test tooling, not product behavior. See PRODUCT_GAPS_FOR_SOCIAL.md GAP-1 for the original (now superseded) observation, and docs/report/TAWVEERI-CURRENT-STATE-2026-09-06.md for the final verified truth.
capabilities.safe_claim: Ask Tawveeri a natural follow-up like 'what if my budget were higher?' or 'cheaper?' and it answers honestly with a real comparison or an explicit 'no change' verdict
capabilities.unsafe_claim: none identified
capabilities.evidence_reference: Live browser test, 2026-09-06 (event-driven re-verification, same day as the original GAP-1 observation)
capabilities.live_repro: click 'لو رفعت الميزانية 500؟' and 'طيب أرخص؟' after the phone camera+budget journey
capabilities.notes: STATUS CORRECTED same-day from an earlier RED_UNSUPPORTED entry in this same file. The earlier entry described a real observation at the time it was written, invalidated later the same session -- see docs/report/TAWVEERI-CURRENT-STATE-2026-09-06.md for the full correction narrative.

capabilities.user_intent: Shopper describes their home (rooms, family size, budget, priorities) at /ar/home-mission, taps an example or writes their own, reviews the understood mission, and builds a full multi-category purchase plan
capabilities.supported_behavior: Confirmed working end-to-end on final event-driven re-verification: example-chip tap populates the intake textarea, 'راجع المهمة' (Review mission) transitions to an editable mission card (property type, per-category quantities, per-room AC areas, spending posture), 'ابنِ الخطة' (Build my plan) calls the real API and renders a full plan with real budget allocation (e.g. 20,000 SAR budget / 16,075 SAR allocated / 3,925 SAR remaining), per-room AC capacity matches, real prices, and honest per-item evidence disclosures (e.g. 'بدون تأكيد الموديل' when confidence is insufficient).
capabilities.unsupported_behavior: None found in this re-verification. Real-world completion RATE (do shoppers who start actually finish the multi-store purchase checklist) was NOT re-measured this session -- that is a separate, unretracted business-analytics fact (August founder review recorded real engagement with zero completions) and must not be assumed to have changed just because the technical submit flow was confirmed to work.
capabilities.known_limitations: Actual shopper completion-rate data is stale (last measured August 2026) and out of scope for this pack's live re-verification.
capabilities.safe_claim: Tawveeri can build a real, multi-category home purchase plan from a free-text description of your home, budget, and priorities
capabilities.unsafe_claim: Most shoppers who start a home plan finish it -- this is not established one way or the other by this pack
capabilities.notes: STALE-CLAIM CORRECTION: an earlier coordinate-based click test this same session found no visible progression on this exact flow and it was reported as broken. That observation was invalidated by this later event-driven reproduction -- root cause was a browser-automation coordinate/devicePixelRatio mismatch, not product behavior. This is a new capability entry (Home Mission had no prior row in this file); see docs/report/TAWVEERI-CURRENT-STATE-2026-09-06.md and TAWVEERI-CAPABILITY-TRUTH-2026-09-06.md for full detail.
